[FACT] User is interested in photography, specifically capturing Instagram-worthy shots.  
[ASSISTANT] Recommended photo opportunities in Erie, including:  
[ASSISTANT] 1. Presque Isle State Park - scenic views of Lake Erie, beaches, lighthouses, and landscapes.  
[ASSISTANT] 2. Erie Maritime Museum - historic U.S. Brig Niagara.  
[ASSISTANT] 3. Lake Erie Arboretum at Frontier Park - wetlands, forests, and natural habitats.  
[ASSISTANT] 4. Erie Bicentennial Tower - city and lake views from the top.  
[ASSISTANT] 5. Downtown Erie - opportunities for street photography.  
[ASSISTANT] 6. Waldameer Park and Water World - roller coasters and family fun.  
[ASSISTANT] 7. Erie Art Museum - artistic and cultural ambiance.  
[ASSISTANT] 8. The Erie Zoo - decorated grounds with plants, trees, and animals.  
[ASSISTANT] 9. Erie Canal - scenic views, colorful landscapes, bridges, and rustic boats.  
[ASSISTANT] 10. Asbury Woods Nature Center - outdoor nature shots with trails and exhibits.  
[PREFERENCE] User expressed enthusiasm for sunrise shots.  
[ASSISTANT] Recommended Presque Isle State Park for sunrise shots, specifically the North Pier at the Waterworks area or Beach 11 area.  
[ASSISTANT] Suggested checking the weather forecast and arriving at least 30 minutes before sunrise.  
[ASSISTANT] Advised to set up equipment and scout the perfect spot the day before.  
[ASSISTANT] Mentioned the importance of having appropriate lighting gear for low light conditions.  
[ASSISTANT] Provided tips for taking great sunrise photos, including:  
[ASSISTANT] 1. Scout the location beforehand for the best view.  
[ASSISTANT] 2. Use a tripod to keep the camera steady.  
[ASSISTANT] 3. Experiment with camera settings (exposure time, aperture, ISO).  
[ASSISTANT] 4. Include foreground elements for depth and interest.  
[ASSISTANT] 5. Be patient and wait for the perfect moment.  
[ASSISTANT] 6. Use accessories like filters to protect the lens and adjust light.  
[ASSISTANT] 7. Shoot in raw format for better post-processing options.  
[ASSISTANT] 8. Adjust white balance to avoid overly warm or cold photos.  
[ASSISTANT] 9. Enjoy the moment of taking sunrise photos as a peaceful time of day.
